caveat: The municipality identity list is current to June 3, 2026. FIR years are municipality-submitted historical filings selected independently per municipality from the locked 2025, 2024, and 2023 bulk files. FIR data may be incomplete or revised and is not a current tax bill, tax-rate by-law, receipt, formal audit, finding, or publication approval. Years are never blended.
